newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Flight says hires Merrill Lynch.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Flight says hires Merrill Lynch.

text.p: Interactive Flight Technologies Inc said Friday it has hired Merrill Lynch to advise it on corporate strategic planning and other issues.

The company said it felt it was important to explore all of its strategic alternatives after the recent decision by Qantas Airways to postpone the purchase of an interactive in-flight entertainment system.

On July 29, Interactive said Qantas had decided not to install a new Interactive in-flight entertainment system for its long haul fleet. It said it had previously been selected to possibly supply the system.
